faqs.q: Do you repair both PlayStation and Xbox consoles?
faqs.a: Yes. We repair PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S consoles, plus PS4 DualShock, PS5 DualSense and Xbox controllers.

faqs.q: How much does a PS5 or PS4 repair cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the fault. We diagnose the console first — diagnosis is free — and give you a firm price before any work starts. Send us a WhatsApp message with the model and the problem for a quick idea.

faqs.q: How long does a console repair take?
faqs.a: Most console repairs take 2–4 days. Cleaning and thermal paste takes 1–2 days, and controller repairs such as stick drift are usually done the same day or the next day.

faqs.q: Can you fix PS5 controller stick drift?
faqs.a: Yes. We replace the worn analog stick modules on DualSense, DualShock 4 and Xbox controllers, which fixes drift properly rather than just recalibrating it.

faqs.q: My PS5 or PS4 turns on but shows no picture. Can it be fixed?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. No display is most often a damaged HDMI port or a faulty HDMI chip on the mainboard. We test the console to find the exact cause before quoting.
